dedupe_keys.name: madrid updated cartography building heights map service

description: Dirección General de Planificación Estratégica, Madrid City Council publishes a map service showing the height changes of each building, with the height estimated as the difference between the maximum elevation of each height-change polygon and the minimum elevation of the building footprints; the page points to the city geoportal for the complete information and services of the dataset. Coverage: the city of Madrid; the portal lists the update frequency as undefined and the record was last modified on 2026-07-23. Format and access: WMS, ZIP, downloadable without registration from the Madrid City Council open data portal (datos.madrid.es). Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0, legal code in Spanish on the portal); cost: free. Caveats: the page says heights are estimated and that omissions of height changes (under 1.5 percent of the total) can occur below the tolerance of the cartography, with precision improvements planned; the files were not opened. Simulation uses: building height inputs for urban wind, shading, heat and solar-potential models and for building-stock exposure classification. Related catalogue records: Arbolado en parques y zonas verdes de Madrid (municipal tree inventory, yearly files) (data-madrid-arbolado-parques-zonas-verdes); OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
